normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 10 amenity access bands.**- Conveniently located in the Camp District of WaterColor- Furnished porch- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutLOCATION: This home is located in WaterColor's Camp District.Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: This is coastal living at its finest. The beaches of WaterColor are just a short bicycle ride or walk away, as are so many WaterColor amenities such as the Tennis Center, the Boat House and the spectacular neighborhood pool. This lovely home offers a gourmet kitchen which features stainless steel appliances, a gas stove and wooden butcher block countertops. The kitchen transitions into a beautifully appointed dining room and living room, which offers a TV/DVD/Bose stereo ensemble. The fourth bedroom doubles as a second living area, and features a TV/stereo entertainment center. Friends and family can kick back under the ceiling fans on the furnished porch after a day on the beach. Starting on the first floor, the primary suite has a king bed, a TV/DVD ensemble and its own bath which features a separate claw-foot tub and shower. The second bedroom has a king bed, a TV/DVD entertainment center, and also has its own bath with a shower only. The third bedroom has a double bed and a shower bathroom with a single vanity. The fourth bedroom, which is on the second floor, has two full over full bunk beds and queen sleeper sofa, a shower bathroom with a double vanity. The separate den is a favorite with the kids. An outdoor shower is the perfect place to rinse off after a day at the beach. This home also has an outdoor propane grill and a car port.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Full Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Two Full over Full Built In Bunk Beds and Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower Only WATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preservesWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Per HOA Policy, all Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Homes are permitted one Low-Speed Vehicle per home. Homes with owner provided Low-Speed Vehicles are not permitted to rent an additional Low-Speed Vehicle.
